{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ImagePipeline where

import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftR)

-- Circuit breaker states
data CBState = Closed | Open | HalfOpen deriving (Eq, Show)

data CircuitBreaker = CircuitBreaker
  { cbState       :: IORef CBState
  , cbFailures    :: IORef Int
  , cbLastFailure :: IORef UTCTime
  , cbThreshold   :: Int
  , cbTimeout     :: NominalDiffTime
  }

data RateLimiter = RateLimiter
  { rlBuckets    :: MVar (Map.Map ClientId TokenBucket)
  , rlMaxTokens  :: Int
  , rlRefillRate :: Double  -- tokens per second
  }

data TokenBucket = TokenBucket
  { tbTokens    :: !Double
  , tbLastCheck :: !UTCTime
  } deriving (Show)

type ClientId = Word64

data ImageRequest = ImageRequest
  { reqClientId  :: ClientId
  , reqPayload   :: ByteString
  , reqTimestamp :: UTCTime
  } deriving (Show)

type ByteString = String  -- simplified

data PipelineResult = Processed | RateLimited | CircuitOpen | Rejected
  deriving (Eq, Show)

-- Initialize rate limiter with 10 requests per minute
newRateLimiter :: IO RateLimiter
newRateLimiter = do
  buckets <- newMVar Map.empty
  return $ RateLimiter buckets 10 0.167

newCircuitBreaker :: IO CircuitBreaker
newCircuitBreaker = do
  state <- newIORef Closed
  failures <- newIORef 0
  now <- getCurrentTime
  lastFail <- newIORef now
  return $ CircuitBreaker state failures lastFail 5 30

-- Normalize client identifier for rate limiting lookup
-- Uses folding to map related client sessions to same bucket
normalizeClientId :: ClientId -> ClientId
normalizeClientId cid =
  let folded = cid `xor` (cid `shiftR` 32)
  in folded `xor` (folded `shiftR` 16)

-- Check and consume a token from the bucket
consumeToken :: RateLimiter -> ClientId -> UTCTime -> IO Bool
consumeToken rl clientId now = do
  modifyMVar (rlBuckets rl) $ \buckets -> do
    let normalizedId = normalizeClientId clientId
    let bucket = Map.findWithDefault (TokenBucket (fromIntegral $ rlMaxTokens rl) now) normalizedId buckets
    let elapsed = realToFrac (diffUTCTime now (tbLastCheck bucket)) :: Double
    let refilled = min (fromIntegral $ rlMaxTokens rl)
                       (tbTokens bucket + elapsed * rlRefillRate rl)
    if refilled >= 1.0
      then do
        let newBucket = TokenBucket (refilled - 1.0) now
        return (Map.insert normalizedId newBucket buckets, True)
      else do
        let newBucket = TokenBucket refilled now
        return (Map.insert normalizedId newBucket buckets, False)

-- Check circuit breaker state
checkCircuitBreaker :: CircuitBreaker -> IO CBState
checkCircuitBreaker cb = do
  state <- readIORef (cbState cb)
  case state of
    Open -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      lastFail <- readIORef (cbLastFailure cb)
      if diffUTCTime now lastFail > cbTimeout cb
        then do
          writeIORef (cbState cb) HalfOpen
          return HalfOpen
        else return Open
    other -> return other

recordFailure :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordFailure cb = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  writeIORef (cbLastFailure cb) now
  modifyIORef' (cbFailures cb) (+1)
  failures <- readIORef (cbFailures cb)
  when (failures >= cbThreshold cb) $
    writeIORef (cbState cb) Open

recordSuccess :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordSuccess cb = do
  writeIORef (cbFailures cb) 0
  writeIORef (cbState cb) Closed

-- Main pipeline entry point
processImage :: RateLimiter -> CircuitBreaker -> ImageRequest -> IO PipelineResult
processImage rl cb req = do
  cbState <- checkCircuitBreaker cb
  case cbState of
    Open -> return CircuitOpen
    _ -> do
      allowed <- consumeToken rl (reqClientId req) (reqTimestamp req)
      if allowed
        then do
          result <- performImageProcessing (reqPayload req)
          case result of
            Left _err -> do
              recordFailure cb
              return Rejected
            Right _ -> do
              recordSuccess cb
              return Processed
        else return RateLimited

-- Simulated image processing
performImageProcessing :: ByteString -> IO (Either String ByteString)
performImageProcessing payload
  | length payload > 10000000 = return $ Left "payload too large"
  | null payload = return $ Left "empty payload"
  | otherwise = return $ Right ("processed:" ++ payload)

-- Batch processing endpoint - processes multiple images
-- Circuit breaker check happens once, rate limit per-image
processBatch :: RateLimiter -> CircuitBreaker -> [ImageRequest] -> IO [PipelineResult]
processBatch rl cb reqs = do
  cbState <- checkCircuitBreaker cb
  case cbState of
    Open -> return $ map (const CircuitOpen) reqs
    _ -> mapM (processSingleInBatch rl cb) reqs

-- In batch mode, when circuit breaker is half-open, we bypass rate limiting
-- to allow a probe request through to test if downstream is healthy
processSingleInBatch :: RateLimiter -> CircuitBreaker -> ImageRequest -> IO PipelineResult
processSingleInBatch rl cb req = do
  state <- readIORef (cbState cb)
  case state of
    HalfOpen -> do
      -- Probe request: skip rate limit to test downstream health
      result <- performImageProcessing (reqPayload req)
      case result of
        Left _err -> do
          recordFailure cb
          return Rejected
        Right _ -> do
          recordSuccess cb
          return Processed
    _ -> do
      allowed <- consumeToken rl (reqClientId req) (reqTimestamp req)
      if allowed
        then do
          result <- performImageProcessing (reqPayload req)
          case result of
            Left _err -> do
              recordFailure cb
              return Rejected
            Right _ -> do
              recordSuccess cb
              return Processed
        else return RateLimited
